About me

A good eye for the little things.

I have a good eye for photography and small visual details — light, angles, the way a frame comes together. I enjoy creating and editing content and experimenting with different creative ideas, from a single photo to a short edited video.

I’m still building my skills, and that’s part of the fun — I’m continuously learning new editing techniques and ways to tell a visual story better than I did the time before.

Creative experience

From making to learning

My experience with multimedia has grown through hands-on team work and personal projects. In Enactus, I contributed to TikTok content and Eid giveaway materials, which gave me experience creating content with a team, working around deadlines, and adapting ideas to what a project needs.

I’m also actively trying to improve: learning new editing tricks, paying more attention to visual details, and experimenting with different ways to make a photo or short video tell a clearer story.

Looking ahead

Still learning, still shooting, still editing.

I’m always looking to sharpen my eye, pick up new techniques, and get better at turning simple ideas into strong visual content.
